ctx.x: But Milt did most of the writing. Of course, Milt got no credit for anything he did.

And I think I feel free today to say things that happened that I didn't think was right and -- in the music business. I'm in it, and I wouldn't want it done to me. But Curly Hamner came in the band, and Curly got a check for
$2,200.00 and Gladys got one for $2,200.00. Hamp got one for $2,200.00, and Milton Buckner did the tune, and he got 600.00.
